title: An answered join request reads Approved or Declined in Team updates, Inbox rows draw no face, and the invite wizard (D3), Approve (V3) and site Settings (D) keep their rules
steps: With a test database (TEST_DATABASE_URL set as in the tracy-web suite) also run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/team-notifications.test.mjs
expect: The first run exits 0 with 0 failed and 0 skipped tests.

rows.test.mjs: outcomeKeyOf('team.join_request', 'approved') is 'outcome.approved' and 'declined' is 'outcome.requestDeclined'; a settled join request in sections.test.mjs is filed under the in/out category by its outcome.
no-face.test.mjs: the rendered Inbox rows contain no [data-tracy-face].

team-invite.test.mjs: the wizard offers only roles every ticked site accepts, a site whose seat cannot invite the chosen role cannot be ticked, the open site is listed first and marked, the Sites rows carry the book's CMS logo, Done offers Invite more with the role kept, and Approve shows the requester, folds the permission list and sends the picked role.
team-notifications.test.mjs (database run): approving or declining a join request writes data.outcome 'approved' or 'declined' on every Owner and Admin request row.
fence: Mechanism checks over the real components and door helpers: the outcome written by settleByRef and read by the Inbox row, the role/site rules of the wizard, and the Settings rows per CMS. The live dsh page and real mail delivery are outside this case; the stand screenshots in the PR cover them.
